title.text: Reallocation has fallen faster outside London, so London increasingly drives the link with productivity
subtitle: Reallocation rate against GVA per hour by ITL2 region, pooled over each period. Dot size = employment; dashed line = linear fit.
Productivity relative to the UK in the same years. Northern Ireland excluded in 2004–08 and from 2011 in 2010–14.
Sources: ONS Longitudinal Business Database (Secure Access, SN 9501); ONS Subregional productivity (June 2025); authors' calculations.
